new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/harvested"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("<uuid>")
.forward(
        forwardOverriddenRequest()
                .withResponseModifier(
                        responseModifier()
                                .withHeaders(
                                        headers(
                                                new Header("X-Server-Error", "true")
                                        ),
                                        null,

                                                .withStatusCode(503)

                                )
